info.name: MiniWallet - Manual Feature Tests
info.description:
Manual feature tests for the local Mini Wallet Platform.

START HERE
1. Select the MiniWallet Local environment.
2. Open 00 - Login and service health -> Login as player. Authorization -> Get New Access Token -> sign in at Keycloak -> Use Token -> Send. The response verifies your identity and automatically saves player_token.
3. Repeat Login as admin with admin / Admin123!. It saves admin_token separately. Use your registered player or player / Player123! for the player flow.
4. Send the remaining requests manually in folders 01 through 07. Request descriptions explain their expected responses. Folder 08 contains optional fresh-account checks.

Postman's OAuth helper performs the authorization-code + PKCE S256 token exchange against Keycloak. The dedicated mini-wallet-postman client registers Postman's callback URLs; password grant remains disabled. The login requests call userinfo to validate the selected account and save the token for the existing bearer-auth requests. Tokens expire after five minutes: refresh or get a new token in the matching Login request, Use Token, and Send again.

New Docker installations import the Postman client automatically. For an existing Keycloak database, run ./postman/Configure-Keycloak.ps1 once from PowerShell; it adds/updates only the dedicated Postman client without resetting data.

Profiles and money are real changes to LOCAL demo data. Returned player_id / bonus_id / bet_id / win_id / cursors are saved automatically. BONUS 100, BET 10 and WIN 15 increase an existing USD balance by 105; a fresh player finishes at 105.

Idempotency keys use a generated run_id and remain stable for retries. For an intentionally new money demo with the same player, clear run_id, bonus_id, bet_id, win_id and expected_usd, then restart folder 03 from BONUS. Do not clear these when merely retrying. Switching player and reading/creating the profile resets the demo IDs automatically.

Repository guide: postman/README.md. Do not run the entire collection blindly: optional checks depend on specific account state. No tokens are shipped in these files.

item.name: 00 - Login and service health
item.description: Select MiniWallet Local, then use each Login request: Authorization -> Get New Access Token -> Keycloak sign-in -> Use Token -> Send. The token is saved automatically. The two health requests need no token.

request.description:
Get your player token entirely from Postman:
1. Open this request's Authorization tab. OAuth 2.0 / Authorization Code (With PKCE) is configured.
2. Click Get New Access Token. Sign in at Keycloak as your registered player (or player / Player123!).
3. Accept the return to Postman and click Use Token.
4. Click Send on this request. A 200 userinfo response verifies the account and saves player_token automatically in MiniWallet Local. Other API requests already use that variable.

If the token expires, reopen this request, refresh the token in Authorization (or Get New Access Token), Use Token, and Send again to update the environment. Do not put an admin token in the player slot: this request rejects that mistake so permission tests remain meaningful.

The token exchange is performed by Postman's OAuth helper: POST /protocol/openid-connect/token with grant_type=authorization_code, code, code_verifier, client_id and redirect_uri. Passwords are entered only on Keycloak's login page. This GET verifies and captures the issued token; it is not a business API login endpoint.

exec: if (pm.response.code !== 200) throw new Error("Open Authorization, Get New Access Token, sign in, Use Token, then Send again.");
if (!token) throw new Error("No OAuth access token selected. Click Use Token before Send.");
if (!part) throw new Error("Expected a JWT access token.");
// Userinfo validates the token at Keycloak. These checks catch an accidental wrong account or token selection.
pm.test("Correct account, audience and unexpired token", () => {
if (!valid) throw new Error("Choose the " + role + " account and its access token. The environment token was not replaced.");

item.name: 03 - Wallet happy path
item.description: Send in order. Requires both tokens and a saved player_id. BONUS 100 -> BET 10 -> WIN 15 increases USD by 105 on the first execution. A fresh player ends at 105; an existing player retains their earlier balance/history. Wait for provisioning before BONUS. Repeated sends keep the same idempotency key.

Wait until 200 before continuing. If the worker is still provisioning, 409 player_not_provisioned with Retry-After: 2 means wait two seconds and Send again. Fresh wallets start at zero; existing money is preserved.

Expected HTTP status: 200. Authentication: player.
